proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#4
proposed.text: Powell leads a warrantless task force raid on Kirsten's law office and questions her about Jack Duquesne, but she refuses to give him up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A lawyer whose office Powell raids. Refuses to give up Duquesne.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the warrantless task force raid on Kirsten's office.

changes.evidence: In 'Gloves Off' (BA S2E4) the AVTF bursts into the Murdock & McDuffie office; Powell tells Kirsten the Safer Streets Initiative means no warrant is needed and interrogates her on Duquesne's whereabouts, which she deflects. Their only direct exchange; in S1 Matt, not Kirsten, questions Powell at the trial while she sits at the defense table.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#6
now.text: Powell joins Fisk's new Anti-Vigilante Task Force, set up to hunt masked vigilantes.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hector's lawyer. Powell jumps him and suggests killing him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Arrests Matt's client Hector and jumps Matt. Serves on Fisk's task force.

changes.evidence: The S1#6 stage only says Powell joins Fisk's task force; nothing passes between Powell and Matt in that title (Excessive Force: Fisk recruits Powell, North and others). A stage must say what happens between the two.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
proposed.text: After Matt reveals in court that he is Daredevil, Powell orders a sniper to shoot him outside the courthouse, but the real Bullseye fires at Fisk instead. Both end up in prison at Rikers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hector's lawyer, revealed as Daredevil. Powell orders him shot outside the courthouse.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Arrests Matt's client Hector and jumps Matt. Later orders him shot outside the courthouse.

changes.evidence: In 'The Southern Cross' (BA S2E8), after Karen's trial, Powell signals the AVTF sniper team to shoot Murdock in the lobby; the real Bullseye answers and shoots at Fisk. Afterwards Powell and the AVTF are imprisoned at Rikers, passing Murdock, who is also arrested. (The AVTF ambush that shoots Matt in the leg, commanded by Powell, is in S2E7.)

now.title: Luke Cage S2#9
now.text: Tom Ridenhour takes over Priscilla Ridley's precinct when she is promoted to deputy chief. After he is killed, Ridley returns to lead it.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ridley's successor at the precinct, after whose murder she returns.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Ridenhour's predecessor at the precinct, who returns after his murder.

proposed.text: After Ridenhour is murdered, Ridley returns to lead his precinct and tells Misty about the lessons she learned from him over the years.

changes.evidence: Ridenhour replacing Ridley on her promotion is stated in Luke Cage S2E1 ('Soul Brother #1', already stage 0). Stage 1 repeats it at S2#9. In S2E9 'For Pete's Sake' Ridley returns to the precinct after his murder (S2E7) and says 'I learned a lot of lessons from Tommy Ridenhour over the years.' They never share a scene, but that on-screen statement keeps the tie.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#2
proposed.text: Fisk offers FBI agent Ray Nadeem a deal and becomes his informant, and Fisk's tip lets Nadeem take down the Albanian mob.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Kingpin, whose tips Nadeem uses to bring down the Albanians.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The FBI agent who takes Fisk on as an informant.

changes.evidence: Nadeem meets Fisk at Rikers in DD S3E1, where Fisk asks for a deal; in S3E2 Fisk's information lets Nadeem take down the Albanian Syndicate, and Nadeem fights to keep running Fisk as his informant and moves him to the hotel. The connection's first stage is at S3#9 (the blackmail), missing seven episodes of them working together.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: Hattley brands the dead Nadeem a killer, but his dying declaration names her as Winn's murderer, and once Fisk is arrested she corroborates it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Nadeem's FBI boss, whom his dying declaration names as Winn's killer.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Hattley frames for murder, whose dying declaration exposes her.

changes.evidence: In 'A New Napkin' (DD S3E13) Hattley holds a press conference blaming Nadeem for Winn's murder; his released dying declaration names Hattley as responsible for Winn's death, and after the arrests she corroborates the declaration.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: Once Fisk is arrested at his wedding and can no longer hurt her daughter, Hattley corroborates Nadeem's dying declaration against him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Kills one of Tammy's children to force her obedience, until she turns on him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An FBI chief Fisk forces to serve him, who then backs the evidence against him.

changes.evidence: DD S3E13: after Fisk and the agents on his payroll are arrested at the Presidential Hotel, Hattley, knowing Fisk can no longer hurt her daughter, corroborates Nadeem's dying declaration, which helps Tower and the NYPD take down Fisk's network.

now.title: Iron Fist S1
now.text: Madame Gao calls her champions to the Da Jue Zhan, a duel to the death against the Iron Fist.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Their mistress, who calls them to duel the Iron Fist to the death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Her champions, called to duel the Iron Fist to the death.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His mistress, who calls him to duel the Iron Fist to the death.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of her champions, called to duel the Iron Fist to the death.

changes.evidence: Scythe is one person (Gao's third challenger in 'Immortal Emerges from Cave', IF S1E6), but the card lines were copied from the Veznikov brothers' plural pair ('Their mistress', 'Her champions').

proposed.title: Luke Cage S1#8
proposed.text: After Cottonmouth's death, Shades tells Zip and his crew that they work for him now and hands them cash for new clothes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of Cottonmouth's crew, whom Shades takes on after Cottonmouth dies.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Takes over Zip's crew after Cottonmouth's death.

changes.evidence: In 'Blowin' Up the Spot' (LC S1E8) Zip asks about severance and Shades answers 'Y'all work for me now', taking charge of the crew; Zip accepts him as his new boss. The only stage is Zip's attempt on Shades and his death in S1E12.

now.title: Jessica Jones S1#10
now.text: On Kozlov's combat pills, Simpson turns violent, and Trish sends him away, taking some of his pills.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Trish's ex, turned violent by combat pills.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Simpson's ex. Sends him away and takes his pills.

changes.evidence: Trish takes Simpson's combat pills in 'AKA I've Got the Blues' (JJ S1E11), when he locks her in her safe room and attacks Jessica; in S1E10 he only attacks Albert and Trish and is locked out. The stage says she takes his pills, so it cannot start at #10.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S2#2
proposed.text: Simpson has been secretly following Trish to protect her from IGH. After she shoots him in the leg and ties him up, he dies holding off the killer who comes for them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trish's ex, who dies trying to protect her from IGH's killer.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Simpson's ex, whom he dies trying to protect.

changes.evidence: JJ S2E1-2: Simpson trails Trish; in 'AKA Freak Accident' (S2E2) she shoots him in the leg and ties him up, he explains he has been protecting her, then tells Jessica to take Trish and run and is killed by the assailant (Alisa).

Turk and Fisk never meet on screen. Turk works for the Russians and is paid by James Wesley (DD S1E5) for tricking Vladimir; he only speaks of Fisk ('always happy to work for a man with a plan'). Their titles never put them in a scene together (Turk: DD S1E1/3/5/11/13, S2E1/13; Fisk is never with him). Knowing about someone is not a connection.

Hernandez never meets Rawlins alive in The Punisher: he learns of him from Madani (S1E10), names him to Marion James (S1E11), and only sees his corpse bagged at Micro's hideout (S1E13). Knowing about someone is not a connection, and Hernandez's part has no huge consequences for Rawlins (Frank kills him).

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: In the final battle, Strange holds up a single finger to tell Tony this is the one future where they win, and Tony takes the Stones and sacrifices himself.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow big ego. Strange signals that his sacrifice is the one way to win.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Signals to Tony that this is the one future where they win.

changes.evidence: During the Battle of Earth, Iron Man glances at Doctor Strange, who signals that this is the one outcome in which they win; Stark then takes the Stones and snaps, dying.

proposed.title: Thunderbolts*
proposed.text: Sent by Valentina to the same vault, Taskmaster saves Yelena from John Walker and tells her she is not there to kill her, moments before Ghost shoots Taskmaster dead.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Red Room escapee Taskmaster hunts for Dreykov, then saves in Valentina's vault.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Dreykov's former hunter. Saves Yelena in the vault, then is shot dead by Ghost.

changes.evidence: In Thunderbolts*, Taskmaster arrives at the O.X.E. vault, kicks U.S. Agent away from Yelena and tells Yelena she is not there to kill her, then is shot in the head by Ghost.

T'Chaka dies in Captain America: Civil War, years before Toussaint is born; they never meet and are never on screen in the same title. A blood tie never met is not a connection, as the stage text itself says.

owner_calls.question: Maggie nurses Matt and counsels him from Daredevil S3#1, but the only stage starts at S3#9, when the family tie is revealed. Add an earlier stage?
options: Add a stage at Daredevil S3#1 (kind friend): the nun who helped raise Matt at the orphanage nurses him back to health after Midland Circle
Add the same stage with kind mentor
Leave as is: the connection starts at the reveal
owner_calls.evidence: Maggie nurses Matt at Clinton Church from S3E1 and they talk throughout S3E1-E7; Matt overhears that she is his mother at the end of S3E8, and she learns he knows in S3E9. The rules don't say which kind fits before the reveal.
